name: Ordered List Generation via N3-Tree Traversal
definition: A method to generate a list of bricks ordered from closest to furthest from the viewpoint to avoid testing blocks behind other untested unloaded blocks, which could cause unnecessary loading of occluded blocks.
summary: Ordered List Generation via N3-Tree Traversal generates a depth-first ordered list of spatial bricks to avoid testing occluded blocks, distinguished by integrating view-dependent axis prioritization into the traversal.
